info.title: PrismCrawl API
info.summary: Search, places, app catalogs, products, and reviews as structured data.
info.description: Retrieve search results, places, products, and public reviews as structured JSON. Supported endpoints can also return the encoded source response. Each completed search consumes one credit, including recognized empty, unavailable, or changed-source results returned with HTTP 200. Validation, authentication, and operational failures remain errors and do not consume a search credit. Continuations are opaque, account-bound, and expire after one hour; restart pagination when a token expires.

ApiToken.name: x-api-key
ApiToken.description: Create or rotate your API token in the PrismCrawl dashboard.

RequestId.description: Unique request identifier. Include it when contacting support.

InvalidRequest.description: The JSON body or continuation is invalid. Invalid, forged, expired, or mismatched tokens are rejected before source work and require restarting pagination. These errors do not spend a search credit. Source inventory changes discovered during a valid request return a completed response instead.

Unauthorized.description: The API token is missing, invalid, expired, or revoked.

ServiceFailure.description: The request could not be completed.

error.message: request failed. no quota has been deducted, please try again or contact support with the request ID.

query.description: A place, business, product, or category query to search on Google Maps.

zero_trace.description: When true, PrismCrawl does not store the normalized JSON response. Audit and billing metadata is retained, but all other data is permanently discarded. Request history exposes only type `ZERO_TRACE`, the request HTTP status code, and whether the account was charged.

zoom.description: Google Maps viewport zoom. Lower values cover a wider area; higher values focus more tightly around coordinates.

start.description: Zero-based Maps result offset. Use multiples of 20 for successive 20-place pages.

query.description: The search query. The UTF-8 representation must not exceed 8,192 bytes; non-ASCII characters may use more than one byte.

html.description: Return Brotli-compressed, Base64-encoded source HTML instead of normalized JSON.

zero_trace.description: When true, PrismCrawl does not store the source HTML or parsed JSON. Audit and billing metadata is retained, but all other data is permanently discarded. Request history exposes only type `ZERO_TRACE`, the request HTTP status code, and whether the account was charged.

device.description: Search as a mobile, tablet, or desktop device.

safe.description: Safe-search mode. `active` enables Google's filtering and Bing Strict SafeSearch; `off` requests unfiltered results. Search providers may still suppress content required by law or policy.

color_scheme.description: Request the provider's light or dark result-page theme. This affects source-page presentation, not ranking, and providers may ignore it.

nfpr.description: Controls Google query correction. `1` asks Google to search the submitted query without automatic spelling correction; `0` keeps normal correction behavior.

filter.description: Requests Google duplicate-result filtering (`1`) or disables it (`0`). Google documents this behavior for Programmable Search, but does not guarantee it for the consumer HTML endpoint used here.

lr.description: Restrict Google result documents by language using `lang_<code>` syntax. Join alternatives with `|`, for example `lang_fr|lang_de`.

cr.description: Restrict Google result documents by country using `country<CC>` syntax. Join alternatives with `|`, for example `countryUS|countryCA`.

start.description: Zero-based result offset. Off-grid values are accepted.

google_domain.description: Google domain used for the search, written without a scheme or `www.` prefix. This is independent of `gl`, `hl`, `location`, and `coordinates`. Supported values follow the search-capable entries in [Google's current domain list](https://www.google.com/supported_domains); `google.cn` is excluded. Case-insensitive.

gl.description: Two-letter Google result-country code. Matching results are boosted rather than strictly filtered. Case-insensitive.

hl.description: Google interface language. This can also influence result selection for international queries. Case-insensitive.

location.description: An Active Google `Canonical Name` from the [pinned geo-target dataset](https://developers.google.com/static/google-ads/api/data/geo/geotargets-2026-07-16.csv.zip). Mutually exclusive with `coordinates`.

coordinates.description: The searcher's latitude and longitude. Mutually exclusive with `location`.

radius.description: Radius in meters used to bias results around `coordinates`; results outside it may still appear. Requires `coordinates`. The maximum is 199 for desktop or an omitted device, and 1,000 for mobile or tablet.

tbs.description: Google's native comma-separated `key:value` advanced-filter container, up to 512 characters. It supports time filters, sorting, and filters associated with a selected search tab. Relative time ranges use `qdr:<unit>[amount]`; custom inclusive ranges use `cdr:1,cd_min:M/D/YYYY,cd_max:M/D/YYYY`. Native filters may vary by search vertical and Google market.
